queries_run: Ralph Lauren distribution channel shift wholesale direct-to-consumer 2026
Ralph Lauren business model transition platform OR subscription OR concession 2026

findings.claim: FY2026 10-K：RL 描述自身為零售、批發、授權三通路並行的多通路組合；批發仍服務約 110 家第三方數位夥伴（主要在歐洲），傳統批發客戶的官網銷售也在增加。未見訂閱化或平台化的商業模式轉變描述。
findings.excerpt: In addition to our conventional wholesale doors, our products are increasingly being sold through the websites of many of our traditional wholesale customers, as well as those of our third-party digital partners. As of March 28, 2026, our wholesale business served approximately 110 third-party digital partners, primarily in Europe.

findings.claim: 10-K 載明公司以地理與通路（零售、批發、授權）分散經營，表示營運結果不單靠單一通路。
findings.excerpt: We diversify our business by geography (North America, Europe, and Asia, among other regions) and channel of distribution (retail, wholesale, and licensing). This allows us to maintain a dynamic balance as our operating results do not depend solely on the performance of any single geographic area or channel of distribution.

channel_business_model_shift.note: 搜尋未找到訂閱或平台化轉型的來源；二手摘要提到 DTC 比重上升，但無可逐字引用原文，未列入。有一則 La Prensa 報導提及新 CEO Larsson，與 RL 現況可能不符，未採用。
